content.short: Avalon USDa is Avalon Labs' Bitcoin-backed CDP stablecoin product for BTCFi lending and DeFi liquidity.
content.description: Avalon USDa is the flagship collateralized debt position product from Avalon Labs, built around a Bitcoin-backed stablecoin for BTCFi users. The system lets Bitcoin holders and DeFi participants use BTC-related collateral to access USDa, a stable asset designed for capital efficiency, liquidity, and use across lending, trading, and yield strategies. Avalon combines CeDeFi lending infrastructure with on-chain stablecoin mechanics so users can keep exposure to BTC while unlocking more flexible liquidity. On Mantle, USDa expands the available BTCFi stablecoin and collateral options for DeFi applications.
